content: 다항식 $p(x)=x^3-ax^2-11x-21$이 최고차항 계수가 $1$인 두 다항식 $f(x), g(x)$의 곱으로 인수분해 되고 $f(7)=0$일 때, $f(1)+g(1)$의 값은? [4.3점]
sourceMathEvidence: The printed stem specifies p(x)=x³−ax²−11x−21, a product factorization into two monic polynomials f,g, and f(7)=0. The score is present in this current payload. Under the standard nontrivial real-polynomial factorization meaning, both factors have positive degree and leading coefficient 1.
solutionMathEvidence: Since f(7)=0 and p=fg, p(7)=343−49a−77−21=245−49a=0, so a=5. Then p=(x−7)(x²+2x+3). The remaining monic quadratic has discriminant 2²−4·1·3=−8<0, so it has no real linear factor. With both factors nonconstant and monic, f must be x−7 and g=x²+2x+3. Thus f(1)+g(1)=−6+6=0, matching choice ②.

decisiveStep.step: After factoring p=(x−7)(x²+2x+3), check Δ=−8 for the residual quadratic and use the nontrivial factorization and monic leading coefficients to conclude f=x−7.
decisiveStep.reason: The negative discriminant excludes a second real linear factor, so f cannot be quadratic; the root condition then assigns the only linear factor to f and fixes the requested sum.
